slides.texte_overlay:
6 manly rules that make
you quietly attractive

1. If She's Telling You
About Her Day... Put the
Phone Away:

• Ask what happened next.
• Remember one detail.
• Full attention is the rarest
thing you can give.

2. If You Make Plans...
Make Them Specific:

• Not "we should hang out
sometime."
• "Thursday, 8pm, that place
you mentioned."
• Clarity is attractive.

3. If You're Nervous...
Say So, Lightly:

• "I'm a bit nervous,
I wanted this to go well."
• Honesty disarms.
• Being real beats
acting cool.

4. If Her Friends Are There...
Talk to Them Too:

• Ask their names.
• Include them in the jokes.
• Her people's opinion
of you matters.

5. If You Have to Cancel...
Call, Don't Text:

• Say why.
• Offer a new day.
• Respect shows in
how you cancel.

6. If You Run Out of
Things to Say... Get
More Curious:

• Read one interesting thing
a day.
• Curious men are never
boring to be around.
